catalogue_requests.reason: No catalogue class is a no-input safe-state action that disables a DC power-supply output: cap.motion.stop.v1 binds motion kinds, cap.motion.estop.v1 is the MHS e-stop latch, and cap.device.configure.v1 is a write class that cannot be a safe_state action. The package uses an x-cap id with an inline (empty) input schema for OUTP OFF.
catalogue_requests.summary: Disable the DC output with OUTP OFF; the declared safe state.

notes:
Passed on the fake backend with python3 -m mhs.driver check; the evidence is contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level. No hardware was attached, visa and the upstream class were never imported, and no hardware backend was run. The package is model-authored and unreviewed (driver.lock.json reviewed_by is null); it claims no human review and no hardware run. The upstream clone has no simulator, tests or captured transcript, so fake.py is an in-memory SCPI stand-in for the commands the driver sends, not a recording; every start value and modelled reading is test data marked '# placeholder'. Covered: the voltage and current set points (VOLT/CURR), the output relay (OUTP), the OVP threshold and enable state (VOLT:PROT, VOLT:PROT:STAT), new MEAS:VOLT? and MEAS:CURR? readings, and the instrument's last FETCh:POW? reading. NOT COVERED: the clone's list mode, output timer, save/recall setups, TTL/DFI and remote-inhibit pins, trigger and status-register configuration, and front-panel key simulation; the driver binds only the primary source, measurement and protection interface. The upstream class cannot be constructed as shipped (misspelled __innit__ and self.instr_address at lines 13 and 36) and the repository asserts no licence, so only its SCPI text is reused. The clone's set_volt and set_ovp check 0 through 30 V while set_curr lists 2200-60-2 and 2200-72-1 models, so no single voltage, current or OVP bound is a device fact: all three numeric writes are Limit.operator_required and are refused MHS.SAFETY.LIMITS_UNSET until the operator supplies site-limits.json. site-limits.example.json is an example-only overlay for a 30 V / 5 A member of the series (0-30 V, 0-5 A, 0-30 V OVP); its numbers are not device facts and must be replaced. The *IDN? probe accepts any non-empty identity because the clone states no expected reply. Risk R3 is set for a source that can reach hazardous voltage and energy and whose connected model range is not stated; the clone documents no hardware emergency-stop input, so estop_physical_ref is not set and the independent stop is the no-input x-cap.aaron-mott.output_off.v1 safe-state action (OUTP OFF). That action is a software command over the same SCPI link, not a safety-rated channel; the physical supply's own protection and any bench disconnect remain authoritative. The hardware backend is the SCPI bridge with host/port or visa_resource; deployment must supply the endpoint, and nothing here validates a live transport. There is no array output to leave uncovered. The catalogue has no class for a no-input power-supply output stop, so the safe-state action is requested as an extension.
